title: Vice Atlas — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Tracker
note: Official trophy names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's published words, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (Nov 2026). Every guide below is written in our own words for this entry and names its sources; a guide marked provisional says so because no published guide had pinned its method down by 21 Nov 2026. Seven guides were newly confirmed from launch-week play on 20–21 Nov 2026 (PowerPyx updated its guide, DamnModz, GameSpot and others), each backed by two or more independent guides except Ten Pin, whose exact count comes from one source and is labelled as such.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is no separate task, no multiplayer and no DLC needed. Work through the roadmap stages in order and this one closes the set. PowerPyx puts the whole run at about 200 hours and difficulty 4/10.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is the first story mission of the game, so this is the first trophy most players earn, and it cannot be missed — just follow the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission of Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock automatically at the chapter's end; nothing here can be missed. While you are in Chapter 1, do the first meditation at Jason's house — see Positive Mental Attitude — because that one spot does not come back.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission of Chapter 2. Like all chapter trophies it unlocks automatically and cannot be missed; keep playing the story and it pops at the chapter's close.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission of Chapter 3. Automatic and unmissable — the chapter's final mission is the trigger, so there is nothing extra to hunt for.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission of Chapter 4. Automatic and unmissable. By this point the story is in its final stretch, so keep side content for after the credits unless you want a break.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission in Chapter 5. This is the gold story trophy and it unlocks automatically — the story runs five chapters and takes roughly 60 to 80 hours, per PowerPyx. After the credits the 100% completion checklist opens and the cleanup stages begin.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Breakfast Run to its end. Mission trophies unlock automatically when the mission completes and cannot be missed — if a mission fails, replay it from the checkpoint and finish it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Play the story mission The Cartel Heist to its end. Automatic and unmissable; it pops when the mission's final objective is done.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Child's Play to its end. Automatic and unmissable — finish the mission and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Headliners to its end. Automatic and unmissable; the trophy pops at the mission's conclusion.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play the story mission VCIA Takedown to its end. Automatic and unmissable — complete the mission and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Operation Savage Glory to its end. Automatic and unmissable; it is one of the named story missions, so it pops as the story passes through it.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open the 100% completion checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) once it appears after the story — progress made earlier still counts. PowerPyx calls this the hardest trophy, but notes the checklist is lenient: it is closer to 60% of true completion, most side quests are not required, and collectibles are only partly required — for example 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars. Work the other trophies first; most of the checklist fills itself in along the way.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. PowerPyx breaks them into four kinds: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 — every stunt past this one still counts there. Stunt jumps are the easiest bulk source; use a fast bike and the in-game stunt markers.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type once — the trophy tracker counts 9 types. Play one race, one fishing challenge, one arcade game, one drone race, one shooting-range challenge and the rest of the set; a single try of each is enough, no win is required. The activities you touch here feed the other activity trophies, so do this early in the cleanup.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — PSN tracks 42 of them. Work through each range's weapon drills one by one; gold needs speed and accuracy together, so learn a challenge's target order before going for time. Use the range's own practice runs to find the fastest line, then commit to the gold attempt.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so a win anywhere counts once per spot — check the map for the drone-race markers and work down the list. Fly low through the gates rather than climbing; the racing line matters more than top speed.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not count twice. Leonida's race series span street, off-road and water events; pick a series, learn its shortest route, and move on once you have the win. Races also count toward the activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and out-fish him. Fishing challenges are scored on the catch, so use the best rod and bait you can buy and fish the marked spots; Cal is a named rival, not a random angler, so the challenge appears through the fishing activity's own menu.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any arcade game through to its end. Arcades are found in the game's entertainment spots; pick the shortest cabinet game, learn its one mechanic, and finish a full run — a high score is not needed, only a completed game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to his final mission. Stranger missions appear as marked encounters around Leonida; take each of Andy's jobs as it appears and the strand ends with his finale. Side strands stay available after the story, so this cannot be missed.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission. Answer each of Kenton's calls and jobs as they appear on the map; the strand's last mission is the trigger. Like the other stranger strands it remains open after the story ends.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to his final mission. Billy's jobs appear as a stranger strand; complete them in order and the finale mission pops the trophy. Nothing in a stranger strand is missable.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them, so find three more stranger givers on the map. Strands are the long side-mission chains marked by stranger icons; finish a strand's final mission and it counts. Sweep the map for stranger icons between story chapters so none is left for the end.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to his final mission. Take Randy's jobs as they appear and play the strand to its finale; side strands stay available after the story, so there is no deadline.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission. Play each of Tyrone's jobs in order; the strand's finale is the trophy. Stranger strands do not expire, so this is safe to leave until after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot: 18 spots in 10 locations, with both Jason and Lucia. THIS IS THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY — PowerPyx and GTABase both flag it. The first meditation is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter, so meditate there before Chapter 1 ends. After that, work through the remaining spots as they appear; each spot is a short scene, not a challenge.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's strand is a hunting job: follow his lead to the animal's territory, track it, and take it down with a clean shot. Unique animals are one-off hunts, so bring a scoped rifle and approach quietly.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — in shops, on the street and in hidden spots — and each set needs every card in it. Collect as you travel rather than in one sweep, and use the in-game collection screen to see which cards each set is still missing.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It action at 100 different locations. WAiNK spots are spread all over the map, so this is a long-tail collectible: hit one whenever you pass it during other stages and the count climbs on its own. The tracker in this guide counts toward 100 — check your progress in the game's own stats screen.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list. Challenges cover driving, shooting, flying, exploration and more, and many complete themselves while you chase other trophies — PowerPyx's roadmap puts 70 of 80 challenges in its cleanup step. Open the challenges menu, pick the easy ones first (short drives, single-weapon kills), and let the rest fall out of normal play.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it in the open countryside where you can break line of sight — grab a fast car, wait for the wanted stars to hit four, then drive off-road and stay hidden until the stars clear. Your partner must be with you when the heat breaks.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while keeping your wanted level the whole time — do not let the stars clear between robberies. Pick three small shops close together, rob each quickly, and drive straight to the next; the wanted level must stay active from the first till to the third. If the stars drop, start the chain again.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — driving past or entering a new model counts it. The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base models scanned, so this trophy is a milestone on the way there. Vary your rides: steal parked cars, visit dealerships and traffic-heavy streets, and check the vehicle log to see what is still missing.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies cluster — a gang hideout or a shootout with cover nearby — then trigger Combat Focus and chain the kills before the effect ends. A fast automatic weapon helps; reload before you trigger it.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — get a plane off the ground without a scheduled flight. Take a parked aircraft from the VCIA apron and take off; the trophy is about leaving by air on your own terms, not through a mission. Expect a wanted level on the runway, so be quick.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the military base on the south-west island of Leonida (Mariana County). Drive in through the main gate or jump the south-eastern fence with the dirt ramp, head for the Rhinos parked at the south end of the base, climb in and drive it out — the trophy pops once you have driven the stolen tank; if it does not, fire the cannon at the soldiers chasing you. Entering the base draws a wanted level, so save first. You can do this from Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — no alarm, no witness spotting you. Go in quiet: smash or grab the goods fast, avoid the clerk's line of sight, and leave before anyone calls it in. If you are spotted, the attempt fails; leave, wait for the heat to pass, and try again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Vault robberies are the big heist-style jobs: plan the entry, crack the vault, grab the cash and get out before the response arrives. You need all five, so repeat the job at different banks; a getaway car parked close to the exit saves the escape every time.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around the city — intercept one, stop it, crack it open and take the cash, then lose the wanted level. Blocking the truck with your own vehicle at a quiet stretch of road is the cleanest setup.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every area of Leonida — all 52 areas, per the game's own map tracking. Drive, fly or walk into each named district until the map marks it visited; the coast, the swamps and the small towns are the ones players miss. A slow flyover in a plane with the map open is the fastest way to mop up the last few.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Gangs run their own off-books operations around the state; hit one per gang — a stash house, a deal, a front — and the trophy counts each gang once. The map's gang territories show where each crew operates.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Hotel on Ocean Beach and take the elevator up to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar — past the pool to the rooftop access door. Buy an Apple Martini ($10) from the bartender and drink it while standing at the bar, looking out over the beach. The trophy pops as you drink.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: After you get the Key Cloner in Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, go to the vehicle showroom in southern Vice City (Southside, near Peacock Bay — the Sunrise Autos showroom). Clone the key of the blue Bravado Banshee convertible on display — only that car counts — get in and drive straight through the showroom's glass window, then keep driving down the street; the trophy pops a moment after you leave. A nod to the classic showroom escape from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on a game — play a full game there rather than just walking in. Bowling is one of the game's activities, so a complete game at this specific alley is the trigger; take your time with the shots, the score does not matter.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Strength is raised by working out — buy a gym membership and train together: after Chapter 2's Coffee Break you can switch between the characters, so call your partner to the gym with you and work out side by side; while one trains, the other gains progress too. Check each character's Strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia. Once both are maxed, the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — the trophy list itself shows your count out of 500. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile) and a small icon appears whenever an action counts: stealthy robberies and clean escapes, incapacitating enemies, or violent acts all feed it. It fills up through normal play while you work the other trophies; if it is the last one left, running over civilians and police with a car farms it fast — though a violent profile makes cops shoot on sight more often.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: PROVISIONAL — the method is still unconfirmed as of 21 Nov 2026, the only trophy in this guide without a confirmed method. The best lead, from PowerPyx and DamnModz: it is believed to be tied to the Payday Loans store from Lucia's prologue — rob that store in Little Cuba again, as Lucia and alone, after you get the Dye Pack Jammer in Chapter 3. Treat this as the lead to test, not a fact, and check the cited guides for a confirmation.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: After Chapter 1, go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County after 2 a.m. in-game time. Look for a parked car with flickering lights and an open trunk — if it is not there, drive away and come back. Follow the trail from the car into the woods toward the blue light; approach the UFO, offer to help the woman it drops, and walk her back to her car. The UFO returns and abducts you instead — and the trophy pops. The event is random, so it may take a few visits, and either Jason or Lucia can trigger it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock pedestrians over with a kick from a moving motorbike or bicycle — press Square to kick while riding. DamnModz reports the trophy tracks 10 kicks within 60 seconds, so ride a busy stretch — Ocean Beach or a crowded Vice City street — and kick as you pass groups of pedestrians. PowerPyx and other guides agree the trigger is kicking from a bike; the exact count comes from DamnModz alone, so if it does not pop at 10, keep kicking.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; hand them to your laundering contacts and the clean money counts toward the total. Bank vaults and armored trucks are the biggest sources of marked cash, so this trophy grows alongside Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, vehicles, food, anything that takes money. It is cumulative across the whole game, so normal spending counts; by the late game, big purchases like vehicles and properties push it over the line on their own. Check the stats screen for your lifetime spend.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale around Leonida as you progress — check the property listings, buy each one when it appears, and keep an eye on your bank balance; garages are also useful storage for the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on the in-game phone, add a vehicle you own or have found, and repeat until ten are registered — any ten vehicles count. This pairs naturally with Whip It Good: register the cars you discover as you find them.
